    max_conv = np.max(conv_result)

    return c1

    c1 = compute_c1(sequence)

        # Make small adjustments to several elements

            idx = random.randint(0, n-1)
            # Add small random perturbation
            perturbation = random.gauss(0, 0.05)
            new_seq[idx] = max(0, new_seq[idx] + perturbation)
        
        # Normalize to keep sum reasonable
